section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics, comparing body appreciation (BAS) and eating disorder symptomatology (EDE-Q) scores of a current sample of Black women with previously published college samples. The current sample showed higher BAS scores than a development sample of primarily White college students and lower EDE-Q scores than a sample of undergraduate women.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics, specifically means and standard deviations, for various measures, which are detailed in Table 1 (not provided). It highlights that the current sample of Black women reported higher average BAS scores compared to a primarily White college student development sample (Avalos et al., 2005). The current sample also showed lower average scores on EDE-Q-R and EDE-Q-EC, but no significant difference on EDE-Q-SC and EDE-Q-WC, when compared to a sample of undergraduate women by Luce, Crowther, and Pole (2008).
